components.name: Palladium / Pd brand and artwork
components.sourceDescription: Actual original supplied PNG/ICO bytes plus source-to-artifact role/hash inventory and copy/container code. The artwork ships under CC-BY-SA-4.0; no vector, font or editable source was supplied or invented.

components.name: Noto Sans SC existing 109-character subset and regular TTF conversion
components.sourceDescription: Existing WOFF2 retained byte-for-byte, not embedded runtime. Static weight400 TTF is its deterministic conversion, not a complete CJK font or icon alphabet.

components.name: Palladium brand import, validation and documentation code
components.sourceDescription: Brand-only AGPL source and existing notices. Full native app source, functional oracles and installed dependency licensing/source/relink remain separate release inputs.

notes: Palladium brand and artwork are distributed under CC-BY-SA-4.0 with attribution to Nickel Studio.
No Qt/libcurl/archive/crypto materials have been substituted by brand-render tool dependencies.
Functional game/loader/defaultmod/Steve/Alex/credits assets retain their original rights.
Material validation does not make nativeReleaseReady or F03 PASS; matching native source/build/dependency/relink evidence is still required.
